query: INSERT INTO mail_jobs (id, user_id, purpose, proof_digest, authority_kind, enqueued_at, next_attempt_at, expires_at, nonce, payload) SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, $4::bytea, $5::text, c.t, c.t, COALESCE($6::timestamptz, c.t + interval '24 hours'), $7::bytea, $8::bytea FROM (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS t) c
